verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a developer CLI and SaaS product like Graphite, but the evidence pack never mentions telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking controls. The cited privacy material covers adjacent topics only: AI features being opt-in, no training on customer data, and emailing support to block AI features org-wide. None of that is an opt-out of telemetry or usage tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
